summary: A collection's directories are optional, but a galaxy.yml at the root is required since it holds the metadata for packaging, building and publishing.
questions: What's the minimum a collection needs?

answer_card.title: Minimum collection structure
answer_card.answer_md: No directories are required unless you have content for them, but a **`galaxy.yml`** at the root is mandatory; it holds the metadata needed to build and publish.
